tools.name: calculator
tools.description: Evaluate one arithmetic expression over + - * / and parentheses. No variables, no functions.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Return the text of one file in the fixture repository.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List the entries of one directory in the fixture repository.

path.description: Repository-relative directory, or '.' for the root.

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Find literal text in the fixture repository and return the matching lines.

query.description: The literal text to find. Not a pattern.

tools.name: search_symbol
tools.description: Find where a function or class is defined in the fixture repository.

symbol.description: The function or class name, e.g. restock_cost.

tools.name: lookup_record
tools.description: Return one customer record by its identifier.

tools.name: database_query
tools.description: Return rows from one fixture table, optionally filtered by one field's exact value.

table.description: The table name: orders or catalogue.

value.description: The value that field must equal.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.description: Return the stock level and location of one SKU.

tools.name: write_sandbox_file
tools.description: Write one text file into the scratch directory. It is not part of the repository.

name.description: A plain file name: letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.

tools.name: run_mock_test
tools.description: Return the recorded result of one test file in the fixture repository.
